name: Ralph Lauren Purple Label
why: The summit of the empire — Italian-made tailoring and cashmere under the gold script; Ralph competing with the houses he once dreamed of.
origin: Launched 1994 as the empire's luxury peak — tailored in Italy by the same workshops as the great houses.
opview: Positions itself as the best of everything Ralph ever imagined.

notes.ital: American dream, Italian make — the Todd Snyder pattern at the summit
notes.racquet: The club version of the club — the highest room in the building, in the softest cloth available. Where Polo dresses the tournament, Purple Label dresses the committee.
